data.one_liner: Provides squishy UI widgets for Flutter
data.what_it_does: The package offers widgets that give a smooshy, elastic feel to UI elements, such as pressable and draggable dough widgets. It also allows custom recipes to tweak the physics of the effect.
use_when: You want a playful, elastic interaction for buttons or cards
You need reusable pressable or draggable widgets with a custom feel
avoid_when: You need complex physics simulations beyond simple squish
You are building a production app that requires strict performance guarantees
strengths: Easy to use out of the box
weaknesses: No built‑in support for advanced gestures like long‑press drag
data.setup_notes: Add dependency, import package, no build_runner needed
